_comment: Known-stale sim/ evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py compares each experiment's NEWEST record's committed per-point netlist snapshots against the design/ netlist that record names as its own provenance; a record produced against a superseded DUT is stale evidence, and stale evidence fails ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades exactly one such failure to a loud note: it names the exact record, the exact DUT netlist, and the exact stale device signature digest. It SELF-EXPIRES two ways -- if the record is re-run the digest no longer matches, and if a NEWER record is appended to the experiment this entry stops matching any check the checker runs. Either way CI fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue; waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call. This is the sim/ counterpart of layout/evidence-freshness-waivers.json. Entries whose check is 'extraction-sources' (issue #309) waive a different thing: a legacy newest PEX record that carries no 'Extraction sources' binding, so its parasitic freshness is NOT checked. recorded_hash there is the sha256 of the record .md itself; the entry self-expires when a newer record lands (it then matches nothing) and becomes an error once the record gains the binding. Such a waiver never covers the record's schematic-DUT check or any other record.

waivers.reason: closed-loop-vref-mc 2026-09-09 record (the untrimmed +/-16% line's own evidence): pre-trim core DUT, superseded by #229's trim-bearing core. The testbench template is already re-pointed at the trim-bearing core at code 128 (#264); the 1800-draw re-run itself was deferred from #264 and is tracked here. The untrimmed-line numbers remain valid history. Hash rebased by #275: D2 now resolves the metal-option trim ladder before comparing (the behavioural RS0-RS7 straps and the XXTRIM call model a mask option, not silicon, and are excluded from the DUT signature -- the same convention layout/lvs_reference.py's convert_with_metal_options applies to the LVS reference), so these snapshots' recorded signature changed from 88fbebb94b0d... to fc1118a5a72f... with no change to the snapshots themselves. The staleness being waived is unchanged: these records still ran against the pre-trim DUT.
